pageDescription: Right-click menu entries added by installed programs (7-Zip, OneDrive, Notepad++…). They can be disabled and re-enabled; deleting is permanent unless you restore the registry backup made before each change.
notAvailableDescription: Context menu management uses the Windows registry and is not available on macOS or Linux.
checkVerbsDetail: Menu entries for files, folders, folder background and drives, for the computer and for your user
checkHandlersDetail: Menu handlers registered with a CLSID, with the DLL that provides them
checkHiddenDetail: Windows, Microsoft and Defender entries and protected ones are not shown
noResultsDescription: Change the filters or scan again.
win11NoticeBody: On Windows 11, classic right-click entries appear under "Show more options" (or press Shift+F10).
filterSearchPlaceholder: Search by name, command or DLL…
protectedTooltip: This entry is part of Windows or a critical app and cannot be modified.
adminTooltip: Modifying this entry requires administrator privileges.
confirmDeleteDescription_one: The entry is removed from the registry. It comes back only by importing the registry backup made before the change or by reinstalling the source app.
confirmDeleteDescription_other: The entries are removed from the registry. They come back only by importing the registry backup made before the change or by reinstalling the source apps.

errors.protected: The entry is protected and cannot be modified.
errors.adminRequired: Access denied: SuperSonicCleaner must run as administrator.
errors.notFound: Entry not found: scan again and retry.

toastScanFailedDescription: Could not list the context menu entries.
toastApplyFailedDescription: Could not apply the requested changes.
elevationPrompt: Some selected entries can only be changed with administrator rights.
